_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Complacency-ceiling coil plus extreme long crowding and near-zero ETF flows favor a one-rung drift lower unless flows and fear/greed reclaim.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls Anxiety/DOWN low-conviction; narrative supplies inflow facts and a bottom analog without a matching forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed breaks below 47 and funding turns flat-to-negative while ETF flows stay near zero
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound and fear_greed pushes above 62 with BTC making a higher high
